text: Suicide is a critical global public health issue, with South Korea exhibiting the highest suicide rate among OECD countries at 24.1 per 100,000 people in 2020. This study focuses on suicidal ideation (SI) within South Korea’s Millennials and Generation Z (Generation MZ) by examining the impact of anger and hwa-byung (HB), a culture-bound anger syndrome.
source_label: Hwa-byung (anger syndrome) as a risk factor for suicidal ideation in MZ generation: a survey study in South Korea
